narrator.name: Data Dave
narrator.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

output.content: {data_dave} brought up the labeling workflow during our sync. He noted that the team currently handles all annotation tasks manually. There is no automated tooling in place for the initial tagging phase. Every sample goes through a human review queue before it hits the training dataset. He described the daily volume as manageable for now, but the process relies entirely on individual keystrokes rather than batch scripts. The current setup means that consistency depends on the specific person working that shift. No machine learning models are assisting with pre-labeling at this stage. The data flows from the raw storage bucket directly to the human interface where the tags are applied. The pipeline operates this way today, without any algorithmic shortcuts or semi-automated suggestions to speed up the initial classification step.
output.reclassify_reason: The text describes the current state of the labeling workflow and data flow without expressing any wishes, refusals, trade-offs, or explicit needs.
